headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / India Today / Al Jazeera
bullets_en: PT Usha exits IOA chief race; Narang, Sachdeva, Mehta in fray.
Revanth Caught Red-Handed, Hence Blaming BRS on Palnadu, Alleges Harish Rao.
Jaish leader admits active terror camps in POK days after Pak minister sought proof.
Guatemala proposes to limit ICC powers, revisit Palestinian probe.
11 injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh tower, Saudi civil defence says.
bullets_ur: PT Usha IOA chief ki dor se peechhe hat gayen, Narang, Sachdeva aur Mehta maidan mein hain.
Revanth rangay hathon pakray gaye, is liye Palnadu par BRS ko dosh de rahe hain, Harish Rao ka ilzaam.
Pak wazir ke saboot mangne ke chand din baad Jaish sarbarah ne POK mein active terror camps ka aetraf kar liya.
Guatemala ki ICC ke ikhtiyaraat mehdood karne aur Palestinian tehqeeq kaazaeri jaiza lene ki tajweez.
Riyadh tower par Houthi hamlay mein 11 log zakhmi, Saudi civil defence ka bayan.
